fileType.text: Windows installer (.exe), digitally signed by PT Nusa Digital

source.text: Downloaded by Bayu himself from the official portal software.nusadigital.test, as noted in IT ticket #3105.

message.text: IT team: the new version of the meeting app is available. Please install it from the office software portal.

explanation: An .exe file is indeed a program, but this installer was requested through an IT ticket and downloaded directly from the office's own portal (nusadigital.test). What deserves suspicion is a program disguised as a document or one that arrives unasked.
hints: A program is not automatically dangerous. Where did it come from?
Read the portal's domain from the right. Was this file actually requested?

sandbox.text: Installs the meeting app. Does not contact unknown servers or read personal files.
